name: XDG Utils with host browser pipe
description: Installs xdg-utils and wraps xdg-open to forward URLs to the host browser through a unix pipe. Binds the host browser pipe into the container at a configurable path; when the pipe is absent, xdg-open falls back to the real /usr/bin/xdg-open.

hostBrowserPipePath.description: Path to the host browser pipe.

containerBrowserPipePath.description: Path inside the container where the host browser pipe is bound. The bind mount source is static and follows the option default; a non-default host path must override the mount in devcontainer.json.
